Historical context

The Tribe’s history explains longstanding alliance with Kiowa people while maintaining a different language and customs.

Living communities and further study

The Indigenous-authored historical exhibition was developed with tribal members; Kiowa’s own account provides context for the alliance without merging the two peoples.

Apache Tribe of Oklahoma ↗

Dianna Everett’s historical reference distinguishes the Plains Apache community from other Apache peoples and outlines its Oklahoma history. Population and program figures are dated.
